instruction: With the model open in SolveSpace, import seed_ss_gui_14_keyhole.dxf from /home/user/Desktop with File > Import, then continue editing that imported drawing rather than starting from an empty document. Launch SolveSpace from `/usr/bin/solvespace` before importing `seed_ss_gui_14_keyhole.dxf`. Do not use File > Open or launch the DXF as a native SolveSpace file. Use the existing outer plate and centerline guides to create the final keyhole plate with outer rectangle 80 x 140 and centerline x=40. The upper large hole has diameter 24 and center (40,95). The lower narrow slot has width 10, and the distance from the slot bottom to the lower tangent point of the large hole is 55. The slot and large hole must be coaxial. Add two diameter 6 mounting holes at (20,20) and (60,20). Construction or guide geometry from the seed may be changed or removed unless it is explicitly required above. When the geometry is complete, align the view to the active workplane if needed, then use File > Export 2d View, choose the DXF file type, and save the result as /home/user/Desktop/final_ss_gui_14.dxf. Do not use File > Save As for this final DXF export.
